archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST mixed with LUXURY

typography.instruction: Add Google Fonts link in public/index.html. Use 'Outfit' for all headings (H1-H4) with tracking-tight. Use 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text for a sterile, objective, corporate aesthetic.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise overlay on dark backgrounds to kill digital flatness and enhance the luxury/enterprise feel.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For Sticky Nav and Overlays: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 with border-b border-white/10. NEVER use pure transparent backgrounds where content scrolls underneath.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal to none. Rely on 1px borders (border-white/10) to create separation rather than heavy drop shadows.

layouts.hero: Faded background image with network visualization (use bg-black/60 overlay to maintain readability). Left-aligned text, massive typography (text-5xl md:text-6xl).
layouts.services: Bento Grid Layout. Asymmetrical grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12). Overlapping cards with 1px borders, solid background, and internal padding (p-8).
layouts.industries: High Density Grid. Images should fade to grayscale initially and transition to full color on hover to maintain a unified dark corporate theme.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy. Use py-24 or py-32 for section separation to provide breathing room.

motion.scrolling: Smooth scroll using @studio-freight/lenis to provide a premium feel.
motion.framer_motion: Subtle fade up and stagger children in grids. Avoid excessive bouncing.

components.navigation: Sticky top, glassmorphism surface, z-50. Navigation links MUST be visible on desktop (no desktop hamburger).
components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm). Primary button solid blue. Secondary button transparent with 1px border and hover transition.
components.contact_form: Use Shadcn components for form elements. Inputs should have subtle backgrounds (bg-white/5) and distinct focus states (focus:ring-1 focus:ring-white). Toast via Sonner on success.

hero_background.description: Blue network lines and dots for a tech/data visualization vibe

about_us.description: Diverse corporate team meeting for authoritative consulting look

industry_health.description: Elderly doctor in white coat at desk

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text over images has sufficient contrast. Use minimum 4.5:1 for normal text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required packages: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react @studio-freight/lenis framer-motion sonner
Create the app in .js/.jsx (NOT .tsx) as per the project requirements.
Update tailwind.config.js to include 'Outfit' and 'IBM Plex Sans' font families.
Implement a SmoothScroll context/wrapper using Lenis for the entire app.
For the Services Section, use @phosphor-icons/react (e.g., Database, Robot, Graph) with Duotone weight for a high-end feel.
In the Hero section, apply an overlay (e.g., bg-black/60) to the background image so the text 'Your trust is our responsibility' is perfectly readable.
DO NOT use generic centered alignments everywhere. Use explicit left alignment for text to match the authoritative consulting layout (like Thoughtworks).
For the contact form, use Shadcn primitives and implement Sonner for form submission feedback.
Ensure the sticky header has a backdrop blur and background opacity. It must NOT be fully transparent.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break the mold. Make it creative and premium.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
